findings: Index case: mastectomy followed by six cycles of fluorouracil/cyclophosphamide/doxorubicin, with 18-month disease-free follow-up. This is not a measurable-tumor response demonstrating fluorouracil or TYMS dependence. EWSR1 break-apart testing was reported, not NR4A3-specific confirmation. The review table mixes diagnoses: cited reports include metaplastic carcinoma (PMID 21347193) and mesenchymal chondrosarcoma (PMID 19136810). Its historical pooled cases must not be treated as a verified EMC cohort. Gupta 2003 chemotherapy response remains secondary evidence with EMC identity unresolved.

citation_checks.reported_diagnosis: Pure primary breast chondrosarcoma; EMC identity not established by abstract
citation_checks.response_claim_provenance: Partial response to three CAF cycles appears in later review tables, not retrieved primary abstract.

cross_study_conclusion: These reports do not validate the TYMS-treatment hypothesis in PeerJ2026. No new efficacy claim.
